description: This file defines the FeignBusinessDateHelper class, which provides methods to manage and manipulate business dates via the FineractFeignClient in integration tests. It includes functionalities to retrieve, update, and temporarily set the business date for testing purposes.

classes.name: FeignBusinessDateHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage business dates in Fineract integration tests, allowing retrieval, update, and temporary date setting.

methods.name: FeignBusinessDateHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with a FineractFeignClient instance.

methods.name: getBusinessDate
methods.description: Fetches the current business date for a given type.

methods.name: updateBusinessDate
methods.description: Updates the business date of a specified type to a new date.

methods.name: runAt
methods.description: Temporarily sets the business date, runs a provided action, and restores the original date afterwards.
